content.text:
Write a natural short email exchange. Subject: Bike pickup. Participants: Me, Riley; Me is the owner's speaker label, not a spoken name. Date: 2026-10-20, local time 10:00–10:20.
Scenario: Riley emails from work to change next week's Saturday pickup because the shop closes early on that pickup day. Riley asks the user to come at 10 am instead of the 2 pm agreed by text, and the user accepts. A brief ordinary email exchange; the day must be the same later Saturday arranged in the texts. No invented quoted history or recap of coffee.

The conversation must naturally and unambiguously establish each of these facts (they are authoring constraints, not lines to copy):
1. They agree to move the bike pickup to 10 am on Saturday of the following week, the same pickup day arranged by text. The shop and address are unchanged.
Use 2–6 short emails. The subject is header metadata; do not put a Subject: prefix inside an email body. Copy quoted earlier messages faithfully; never invent different addresses, dates or wording for them. Return only JSON with dialogue (an array of {"sender": "Name", "body": "email text"}) and writer_note (a short string). Bodies may contain paragraphs and quoted replies using escaped newlines.

output.encrypted_content: <encrypted reasoning retained in private run artifact>

summary.text: Drafting a brief email exchange to reschedule bike pickup to 10am on the same later Saturday.
Structuring a 2-6 email dialogue with quoted replies and JSON output while keeping sender labels and metadata separate from body content.
Selecting a Saturday date and phrasing the email exchange while keeping sender labels and metadata separate from body content.
Validating the two-email thread against timing, venue, and label constraints.

{"dialogue": [{"sender": "Riley", "body": "Hi! Emailing from work with a quick change for our bike pickup.

I just heard the shop is closing early next Saturday, Oct 31. Can we keep the same Saturday we arranged by text, but come at 10 am instead of the 2 pm we had? Same shop and same address, just earlier.

Let me know if that works!

Riley"}, {"sender": "Me", "body": "Hi Riley,

Sure, 10 am on Saturday, Oct 31 works for me. See you at the same shop then.

Thanks for the heads-up!"}], "writer_note": "Riley from work moves Oct 31 pickup from 2pm text time to 10am for early close, same shop; user accepts."}
